newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Edison net sales up in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Edison net sales up in Jan-May.

text.p: Edison, Italy's largest non-state owned producer of electricity, said net sales in the first five months of the year totalled 1.083 trillion, up 43 percent on the same period in 1996.
Managing director Giulio Del Ninno said at a shareholders meeting here gross operating margin was up 40 percent at 516 billion lire and its ratio to turnover remained at 48 percent.

Edison, which is the energy subsidiary of agrichemical group Montedison, said its net financial debts were 764 billion lire at the end of May, down 32 percent from the end of 1996 when they totalled 1.124 trillion lire.
